changes: First release for Digitakt I OS 1.54: a crossfader between two groups of audio tracks and inputs, with an equal-power curve.
The fader is LEVEL on the Internal Mixer, LEVEL on the pages of the tracks you put on FADER ON, or a CC on FX CONTROL CH.
Groups and settings are on SETTINGS > CROSSFADER and are kept for the whole unit; the delay and reverb sends follow the fade.
Known issue: the settings are not per project or pattern, and the fader's position is not saved.
